meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文热门趋势，发现风口题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速掌握平台热门题材
copy.tagline_en: Track short story trends and discover viral topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web novels and want to catch trending themes

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 成为短篇小说市场分析师：根据你指定的平台和写作方向，采集或读取榜单数据，识别高频情绪与题材，输出包含市场概况、情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警、值得写的方向等内容的扫榜报告。
howto.when: 当你说出 “/story-short-scan”“/短篇扫榜”“短篇什么火” 等指令，或询问知乎故事排行时触发。

say.text: 帮我看下知乎盐言最近哪类短篇火
say.note: 会先问你想看哪个平台和方向。

say.text: 扫一版七猫短篇的题材热点和风口
say.note: 输出七猫的扫榜报告和风口预警。

say.text: 对比知乎和七猫的短篇趋势，找值得写的方向
say.note: 做跨平台对比，给出选题建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-story market analyst: it gathers or uses ranking data, analyzes emotions/themes, and outputs a report with market overview, emotion rankings, theme hotspots, trend warnings, and writing suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says /story-short-scan, /短篇扫榜, ‘短篇什么火’, ‘知乎故事排行’, or similar requests about scanning short-story rankings.

say_en.text: Check which short stories are trending on Zhihu Yan.
say_en.note: Asks for platform and direction first.

say_en.text: Scan Qimao short stories for hot themes and trends.
say_en.note: Outputs a Qimao scan report with alerts.

say_en.text: Compare Zhihu and Qimao short-story trends for ideas.
